name: blender-beast
grounded_in: NOT text-grounded: this PDF carries no extractable text layer (14 pages, all images). Kept deliberately — it is the corpus's only image-only manual, and Claude reads it through vision exactly as it would a phone photo of a manual. That is a real production path with nothing else covering it.
notes: Because the text could not be read, NO must_have is asserted. Inventing one would produce a false failure and false failures are how a suite stops being trusted. Scored on the checks that hold regardless of contents: it must produce a valid, untruncated extraction, must not manufacture operation tasks, and must not inflate tiers.

must_not_have.why: Class-level, safe without reading the manual: loading a blender is operation on every blender ever made.
Running the appliance is never upkeep. Anchored to the START of the title so it cannot match 'Clean Blending Vessels', which is care, not operation.
